## Course arc

**Eco → Evo (deterministic → random) → Microbiome (ecology with randomness)**

Canonical materials live under `weeks/week-XX/` (slides, notebook, assignment). Do not recreate week sources under `modules/`.

---

## Setup

Install:

1. Git
2. [Quarto](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/)
3. [R](https://cran.r-project.org/) (for executable chunks)
4. RStudio, or VS Code / Cursor with the Quarto extension

```bash
git clone https://github.com/s-peischl/QuantiativeBiology_I.git
cd QuantiativeBiology_I
quarto --version
```

Open the **project folder** (not a single file) so `_quarto.yml` and relative paths work.

---

## MfB qualification criteria

The Biology BSc “MfB” criteria (logic, maths, probability, data, programming, stats, modelling) define what a degree should touch in years 1–2.

QuBi I **does not cover all of them**. Aim to **touch many** codes deliberately — see the internal map:

- [MfB ↔ QuBi alignment](mfb-alignment.qmd)
- [IMPULS LEHRE proposal brief](impuls-proposal-brief.qmd) (why QuBi exists; what we promised)

Source file (outside this repo): `BridgeCourse/Qualifikationskriterien_MfB_english 1.odt`.  
Proposal PDF: `BridgeCourse/IMPULS LEHRE 2026 Antragsformular zur Einreichung.pdf`.

## Repository map

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `weeks/week-XX/slides.qmd` | Reveal.js lecture deck |
| `weeks/week-XX/notebook.qmd` | Student notebook (HTML) |
| `weeks/week-XX/assignment.qmd` | Assignment (HTML) |

## Editing slides

Edit `weeks/week-XX/slides.qmd`.

### YAML must stay Reveal.js

```yaml
format:
  revealjs:
    theme: simple
    slide-number: true
    embed-resources: true
```

**Do not** set `format:` in `_quarto.yml` or `weeks/_metadata.yml` — that breaks decks.

### Quarto Markdown patterns

```markdown
## One idea per slide

- Bullet A
- Bullet B

## Columns

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
Left
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
Right
:::
::::

## Image

![](../../pics/organisms/paramecium_caudatum_lm.jpg){width="70%" fig-alt="Paramecium"}

## Speaker notes

::: {.notes}
What you say aloud.
:::
```

### Preview the right way

```bash
quarto preview weeks/week-02/slides.qmd
# rendered file:
# _site/weeks/week-02/slides.html
```

Use **Quarto Preview / Render**, not the editor’s plain Markdown preview.

Keyboard: `←` `→` · `M` menu · `Esc` overview · `F` fullscreen.

### New week

```bash
cp templates/slides-template.qmd weeks/week-03/slides.qmd
cp templates/notebook-template.qmd weeks/week-03/notebook.qmd
cp templates/assignment-template.qmd weeks/week-03/assignment.qmd
```

Update titles, navigation links, and content.

## Notebooks and assignments

```bash
quarto preview weeks/week-02/notebook.qmd
quarto preview weeks/week-02/assignment.qmd
```

Do not commit answer keys to `main` unless that is intentional.

## Images and data

- Images → `pics/` (document licenses in `pics/README.md`)
- From a week file, paths look like `../../pics/...`
- Data → `weeks/week-XX/data/` with a short README citing sources

## GitHub: get changes online

### Recommended collaborator flow

```bash
git checkout main
git pull origin main
git checkout -b week-03-slides
# edit…
git add weeks/week-03/slides.qmd
git commit -m "Week 3: draft richer ecology slides"
git push -u origin week-03-slides
```

Open a **Pull Request** into `main`:  
<https://github.com/s-peischl/QuantiativeBiology_I/pulls>

### What happens after merge / push to `main`

GitHub Actions runs **Deploy Quarto Site** (`.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml`) and refreshes Pages.

Watch: repo → **Actions**.  
Site: <https://s-peischl.github.io/QuantiativeBiology_I/>

---

## R plots and Pages (read this)

CI uses `quarto render --no-execute`, so **R is not re-run on the server**.

- Static images always show.
- Plots from `{r}` chunks need committed freeze under `_freeze/weeks/week-XX/`, or a maintainer must enable execution in CI.

After adding plots locally:

```bash
quarto render weeks/week-XX/slides.qmd
git add -f _freeze/weeks/week-XX
git commit -m "Week XX: freeze figures for Pages"
```

---

## Common pitfalls

| Symptom | Likely fix |
|---------|------------|
| Preview is a long page, not slides | Quarto Preview / `--to revealjs` |
| All decks become HTML | Remove stray project/`_metadata` `format:` |
| Broken image links | Paths relative to the `.qmd` folder |
| Site looks old | Wait for Actions; hard-refresh |
| Workflow file push rejected | Needs GitHub `workflow` scope — avoid editing `.github/workflows` unless you have it |

---

## PR checklist

- [ ] Edited `weeks/week-XX/` (not old module trees)
- [ ] Previewed as Reveal.js
- [ ] Images credited if new
- [ ] No secrets / private answer keys
- [ ] New R plots frozen (or flagged for maintainer)
- [ ] Clear commit message
